items.title: Dysfunction of the blood-brain barrier and neurovascular unit in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis - From advanced human models to treatments.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder, characterized by the degeneration of motor neurons, resulting in progressive and eventually complete loss of motor function. The phenotypical heterogeneity of ALS poses a challenge to early diagnosis and treatment, with currently available therapeutics only capable of relieving symptoms and slowing progression. While ALS is classified as a motor neuron disease (MND), research has identified significant impairment to the blood-brain barrier (BBB) and neurovascular unit (NVU) of ALS patients. The BBB along with supporting cells of the NVU selectively control the entry of substances into the central nervous system (CNS) and maintain brain homeostasis, with its many cellular components demonstrating impaired function, specifically relating to inflammation, oxidative stress and TDP-43 proteinopathy. The advent of more advanced in vitro techniques as well as use of patient-derived BBB cells has presented a promising alternative to recreate the in vivo structure of the BBB/NVU in a highly controlled platform. Such approaches have ranged from simple 2-dimensional (2D) cell culture to intricate 3-dimensional (3D) co-culture systems, as well as microfluidic systems and organoids, with a potential to investigate ALS associated BBB/NVU dysfunction and drug discovery. This review provides a comprehensive assessment of known BBB/NVU dysfunction in ALS and methods of investigating this using in vitro and in vivo platforms with a focus on inflammation, oxidative stress and pathological TDP-43 expression. This review also presents a future perspective to overcoming barriers to treatment of ALS using new patient-derived BBB/NVU model systems.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中血脑屏障与神经血管单元的功能障碍——从先进人类模型到治疗
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了ALS中血脑屏障和神经血管单元的功能障碍，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43病理。文章还总结了从2D培养到3D共培养、微流控和类器官等体外模型，以及患者来源BBB细胞在模拟ALS病理和药物筛选中的应用前景。
items.insight: 该综述将BBB/NVU功能障碍置于ALS病理机制的核心位置，并系统评估了患者来源细胞、3D共培养、微流控和类器官等先进人类模型平台。对于ALS研究者而言，这些模型有望弥补动物模型在转化上的不足，并为靶向神经血管单元的药物筛选提供更贴近人类生理的实验体系，值得跟踪其后续在TDP-43蛋白病变和炎症通路上的应用进展。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，以运动神经元变性为特征，导致运动功能进行性并最终完全丧失。ALS的表型异质性给早期诊断和治疗带来挑战，目前可用的治疗手段仅能缓解症状并延缓进展。尽管ALS被归类为运动神经元病（MND），研究已发现ALS患者的血脑屏障（BBB）和神经血管单元（NVU）存在显著损伤。BBB连同NVU的支持细胞选择性控制物质进入中枢神经系统（CNS）并维持脑稳态，其多种细胞组分表现出功能受损，具体涉及炎症、氧化应激和TDP-43蛋白病变。更先进的体外技术以及患者来源BBB细胞的应用，为在高度可控平台上重建BBB/NVU的体内结构提供了有前景的替代方案。此类方法从简单的二维（2D）细胞培养到复杂的三维（3D）共培养系统，以及微流控系统和类器官，具有研究ALS相关BBB/NVU功能障碍和药物发现的潜力。本综述全面评估了ALS中已知的BBB/NVU功能障碍，以及利用体外和体内平台研究这一问题的方法，重点关注炎症、氧化应激和病理性TDP-43表达。本综述还提出了利用新的患者来源BBB/NVU模型系统克服ALS治疗障碍的未来展望。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述聚焦ALS中血脑屏障与神经血管单元功能障碍这一新近受关注领域，并强调患者来源先进人类模型在机制研究和药物发现中的转化价值。

items.title: The thymus gland is a target and maintainer of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis pathophysiology.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by the selective loss of motor neurons in the brain and spinal cord with evidence of local neuroinflammation. Regulatory T cells (Treg) exert neuroprotective effects and correlate with disease progression, but central mechanisms governing Treg development during ALS remain unclear. We investigated the thymic architecture and T cell differentiation in SOD1-G93A (mSOD1) ALS mice at multiple disease stages. Thymocyte and thymic epithelial cells (TEC) subpopulations, as well as stages of Treg differentiation and suppressive capacity, were analyzed by flow cytometry, in situ immunofluorescence, and functional assays. At late disease stage (120 days-old), mSOD1 mice displayed thymic atrophy, reduced thymocyte numbers, and decreased double-positive (DP), CD4 single-positive (SP), and Treg populations. Foxp3 expression per cell was preserved, but Treg progenitors and mature Treg numbers declined, paralleled by reduced suppressive function in vitro . TEC analysis revealed reduced total and mature medullary TEC (CD80 high MHCII high ), despite preserved Aire expression. Foxp3 + cells were abnormally localized at cortical sites, away from mTEC, associated with migratory abnormalities and increased apoptosis. TREC evaluation revealed reduced intrathymic sjTREC, consistent with impaired proliferation and differentiation between DN and DP stages, although peripheral sj/βTREC ratios remained stable. Reduced Treg numbers were also observed in lymph nodes draining affected hindlimbs. Our findings identify the thymus as a target organ in ALS, where thymic involution, TEC loss, and Treg dysfunction may compromise immune tolerance. These alterations likely reinforce the role of the thymus in peripheral immune dysregulation and neuroinflammation observed in ALS.
items.titleZh: 胸腺是肌萎缩侧索硬化病理生理学的靶标和维持者
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1-G93A ALS小鼠模型中发现，疾病晚期胸腺出现萎缩，胸腺细胞和调节性T细胞（Treg）数量减少，胸腺上皮细胞丢失，Treg抑制功能下降，且胸腺内Treg定位异常。这些变化提示胸腺可能是ALS中免疫耐受破坏和神经炎症的重要环节。
items.insight: 这项研究将ALS的免疫失调机制从外周前移到中枢免疫器官胸腺，提示胸腺退化与Treg功能缺陷可能是神经炎症的驱动因素之一。对于关注ALS免疫治疗、Treg细胞疗法或免疫耐受重建的研究者，该研究提供了新的靶点视角和疾病阶段特异性证据，值得进一步验证胸腺功能是否可作为生物标志物或干预节点。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，其特征是脑和脊髓中运动神经元的选择性丢失，并伴有局部神经炎症的证据。调节性T细胞（Treg）发挥神经保护作用并与疾病进展相关，但ALS中调控Treg发育的中枢机制仍不清楚。我们在多个疾病阶段研究了SOD1-G93A（mSOD1）ALS小鼠的胸腺结构和T细胞分化。通过流式细胞术、原位免疫荧光和功能测定，分析了胸腺细胞和胸腺上皮细胞（TEC）亚群，以及Treg分化和抑制能力的各个阶段。在疾病晚期（120日龄），mSOD1小鼠表现出胸腺萎缩、胸腺细胞数量减少，以及双阳性（DP）、CD4单阳性（SP）和Treg群体减少。每个细胞的Foxp3表达得以保留，但Treg祖细胞和成熟Treg数量下降，同时体外抑制功能降低。TEC分析显示总TEC和成熟髓质TEC（CD80高MHCII高）减少，尽管Aire表达得以保留。Foxp3+细胞异常定位于皮质部位，远离mTEC，与迁移异常和凋亡增加相关。TREC评估显示胸腺内sjTREC减少，与DN和DP阶段之间的增殖和分化受损一致，尽管外周sj/βTREC比值保持稳定。在引流受累后肢的淋巴结中也观察到Treg数量减少。我们的发现确定胸腺是ALS的靶器官，其中胸腺退化、TEC丢失和Treg功能障碍可能损害免疫耐受。这些改变可能强化了胸腺在ALS中观察到的外周免疫失调和神经炎症中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了胸腺在ALS小鼠模型中的靶器官地位，将胸腺退化与Treg功能障碍直接联系到ALS神经炎症，具有免疫机制转化价值。

items.title: Exploring the toxicological impact of BDE-209 on neurodegenerative diseases through network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and in-vitro study.
items.summary: Decabromodiphenyl ether (BDE-209) is a persistent flame retardant associated with neurotoxicity, but its potential links to neurodegenerative diseases remain unclear. We integrated network toxicology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and in vitro experiments to investigate BDE-209 in Parkinson's disease (PD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Network analysis identified 90 shared targets, enriched in lipid metabolism, oxidative stress, and inflammatory pathways, including IL-17 and TNF signaling. Docking prioritized the FKBP12-mTOR complex as a candidate binding system, with a score of -8.6 kcal/mol. MD simulations supported the stability of the predicted pose, which was dominated by van der Waals and hydrophobic interactions involving PHE-128 and TRP-190. In differentiated PC12 cells, BDE-209 increased p-mTOR at 10 μM and IL-1β at 20 μM without overt cytotoxicity. Rapamycin attenuated the p-mTOR response, supporting mTOR involvement, although mTOR dependence of IL-1β induction was not established. At 40 μM, BDE-209 reduced viability, potentially confounded by precipitation or aggregation. These findings implicate mTOR dysregulation in BDE-209 cellular responses, but direct binding, chronic exposure, and in vivo disease relevance require further validation.
items.titleZh: 通过网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和体外研究探索BDE-209对神经退行性疾病的毒理学影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究结合网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟和PC12细胞实验，探讨持久性阻燃剂BDE-209与帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化的潜在关联。分析识别出90个共有靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路；对接和模拟提示FKBP12-mTOR复合物可能为结合候选，细胞实验中BDE-209可升高p-mTOR和IL-1β，但高浓度下细胞活力下降可能受沉淀或聚集干扰。研究提示mTOR失调可能参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性尚未验证。

items.abstractZh: 十溴二苯醚（BDE-209）是一种与神经毒性相关的持久性阻燃剂，但其与神经退行性疾病的潜在联系仍不清楚。我们整合了网络毒理学、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟和体外实验，研究BDE-209在帕金森病（PD）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中的作用。网络分析识别出90个共有靶点，富集于脂质代谢、氧化应激和炎症通路，包括IL-17和TNF信号通路。对接分析将FKBP12-mTOR复合物列为候选结合系统，评分为-8.6 kcal/mol。MD模拟支持预测构象的稳定性，该构象主要由涉及PHE-128和TRP-190的范德华力和疏水相互作用主导。在分化的PC12细胞中，BDE-209在10 μM时增加p-mTOR，在20 μM时增加IL-1β，且无明显细胞毒性。雷帕霉素减弱了p-mTOR反应，支持mTOR参与其中，但IL-1β诱导对mTOR的依赖性尚未确立。在40 μM时，BDE-209降低细胞活力，可能受到沉淀或聚集的混杂影响。这些发现提示mTOR失调参与BDE-209的细胞反应，但直接结合、慢性暴露和体内疾病相关性仍需进一步验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近整合网络毒理学与体外实验，提示持久性环境污染物BDE-209可能通过mTOR失调与ALS等神经退行性疾病相关，具有环境病因学转化探索价值。

items.title: TBK1 overexpression reduces neuronal loss in the P497S UBQLN2 mouse model of ALS/FTD.
items.summary: Missense mutations in UBQLN2 are linked to dominant inheritance of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) which is frequently accompanied by frontotemporal dementia (FTD). The encoded UBQLN2 protein functions to maintain proteostasis, collapse of which is increasingly being realized as the cause of many neurodegenerative diseases. During investigations of our UBQLN2 mouse models of ALS/FTD, we observed a significant decline in Tank-binding kinase 1 (TBK1) protein in end-stage mice. The decline could be significant, as haploinsufficiency of TBK1 expression is linked to ALS/FTD. To determine whether the reduction in TBK1 levels is responsible for driving pathogenesis, we crossed P497S UBQLN2 transgenic (Tg) mice with BacTBK1 Tg mice that overexpress TBK1 and analyzed the progeny for signs of pathology. The analysis revealed that double transgenic mice had a significant reduction in neurodegeneration in both the brain and spinal cord (SC) compared to P497S single-Tg mice. Double immunofluorescence staining of P497S mouse tissue revealed TBK1 colocalizes with UBQLN2 aggregates in spinal motor neurons. Biochemical extraction studies of mouse brain tissue revealed increased enrichment of TBK1 along with wild type and mutant UBQLN2 proteins in detergent-insoluble material, suggesting TBK1 gets sequestered by UBQLN2 aggregates. GST-pulldown assays revealed that UBQLN2 binds directly with TBK1, but paradoxically the P497S mutation was found to reduce TBK1 binding. Turnover studies indicated that loss of UBQLN2 destabilizes TBK1, providing another route for its reduction. These findings lead us to propose that efforts directed toward increasing TBK1 expression may provide a therapeutic approach for treating ALS/FTD caused by UBQLN2 mutations.
items.titleZh: TBK1过表达可减少ALS/FTD的P497S UBQLN2小鼠模型中的神经元丢失
items.summaryZh: 该研究在小鼠模型中探索了TBK1水平下降在UBQLN2突变所致ALS/FTD中的作用。研究者发现，在P497S UBQLN2转基因小鼠中过表达TBK1可显著减轻脑和脊髓的神经退行性变。机制上，UBQLN2聚集体会隔离TBK1，且UBQLN2缺失会降低TBK1稳定性。作者据此提出，提高TBK1表达可能成为针对UBQLN2突变相关ALS/FTD的潜在治疗策略。
items.insight: 这项研究将TBK1单倍剂量不足与UBQLN2突变相关的ALS/FTD病理机制直接联系起来，并在动物模型中提供了过表达TBK1可减轻神经退行性变的遗传学证据。对于关注蛋白质稳态、TBK1信号通路及UBQLN2相关ALS的科研人员而言，该工作提示TBK1可能是一个可干预的节点，值得进一步验证其在不同遗传背景和疾病阶段中的治疗潜力。

items.abstractZh: UBQLN2的错义突变与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的显性遗传相关，且常伴随额颞叶痴呆（FTD）。所编码的UBQLN2蛋白功能在于维持蛋白质稳态，而蛋白质稳态的崩溃正日益被认为是许多神经退行性疾病的病因。在我们对ALS/FTD的UBQLN2小鼠模型进行研究期间，我们观察到终末期小鼠中Tank结合激酶1（TBK1）蛋白显著下降。这一下降可能具有重要意义，因为TBK1表达的单倍剂量不足与ALS/FTD相关。为确定TBK1水平的降低是否驱动了发病机制，我们将P497S UBQLN2转基因（Tg）小鼠与过表达TBK1的BacTBK1 Tg小鼠杂交，并分析子代是否存在病理迹象。分析显示，与P497S单转基因小鼠相比，双转基因小鼠在脑和脊髓（SC）中的神经退行性变均显著减少。对P497S小鼠组织的双重免疫荧光染色显示，TBK1与脊髓运动神经元中的UBQLN2聚集体共定位。对小鼠脑组织的生化提取研究显示，TBK1与野生型和突变型UBQLN2蛋白在去垢剂不溶性物质中富集增加，提示TBK1被UBQLN2聚集体隔离。GST下拉实验显示UBQLN2与TBK1直接结合，但矛盾的是，P497S突变被发现会降低TBK1的结合。周转研究表明，UBQLN2的缺失会使TBK1不稳定，为其减少提供了另一条途径。这些发现使我们提出，旨在增加TBK1表达的努力可能为治疗由UBQLN2突变引起的ALS/FTD提供一种治疗途径。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，在UBQLN2突变相关ALS/FTD小鼠模型中证明过表达TBK1可减少神经元丢失，为TBK1靶向治疗策略提供了新的临床前转化依据。

items.title: Cellular senescence is an early feature and therapeutic target in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis TDP-43 Q331K mice.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive motor neuron degeneration in the motor cortex and spinal cord. Aging is a key risk factor for ALS, and cellular senescence - a hallmark of aging marked by irreversible cell-cycle arrest and a pro-inflammatory senescence-associated secretory phenotype - has been implicated in neurodegeneration, yet its role in ALS progression remains incompletely understood. Here, we show that molecular markers of cellular senescence emerge in the motor cortex and spinal cord alongside declines in neural and neuromuscular function in TDP-43 Q331K ALS mice, supporting senescence as an early feature of ALS pathology. To test whether reduced senescence ameliorates ALS pathology, we evaluated longitudinal senolytic treatment with dasatinib and quercetin (D&Q) in TDP-43 Q331K mice. D&Q treatment improved motor behavior, neuromuscular function, and reduced axonal damage as measured by plasma neurofilament light chain, accompanied by robust improvements in motor cortex excitability and preservation of layer V neuron counts. At the cellular level, cortical microglia were implicated as a potential mediator of senolytic benefits based on reduced microglial TDP-43 burden and senescence markers. Together, these findings identify cellular senescence as an early, disease-relevant, and modifiable feature of ALS pathology.
items.titleZh: 细胞衰老是肌萎缩侧索硬化TDP-43 Q331K小鼠的早期特征及治疗靶点
items.summaryZh: 该研究在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠模型中发现，细胞衰老标志物在运动皮层和脊髓中早期出现，并与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同步。使用达沙替尼和槲皮素进行衰老细胞清除治疗，可改善运动行为、神经肌肉功能和运动皮层兴奋性，减少轴突损伤，并保留皮层V层神经元。皮层小胶质细胞可能是介导这些获益的关键细胞。研究提示细胞衰老是ALS早期、可干预的病理特征。
items.insight: 这项研究将细胞衰老定位为ALS的早期可修饰特征，并提供了衰老细胞清除药物在遗传性ALS小鼠模型中的多维度获益证据，包括行为、电生理、神经退行性变和液体生物标志物。对于ALS研究者而言，它提示衰老相关机制可能是独立于TDP-43蛋白聚集的上游或并行病理过程，且达沙替尼和槲皮素作为已上市药物，具有较高的临床转化潜力。小胶质细胞作为潜在介导者的发现，也为神经炎症干预提供了新视角。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，以运动皮层和脊髓中运动神经元的进行性退变为特征。衰老是ALS的关键危险因素，而细胞衰老——一种以不可逆细胞周期停滞和促炎性衰老相关分泌表型为标志的衰老特征——已被认为与神经退行性变有关，但其在ALS进展中的作用仍不完全清楚。在此，我们显示，在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中，细胞衰老的分子标志物与神经及神经肌肉功能下降同时出现在运动皮层和脊髓中，支持衰老是ALS病理的早期特征。为检验减少衰老是否能改善ALS病理，我们在TDP-43 Q331K小鼠中评估了达沙替尼和槲皮素（D&Q）的纵向衰老细胞清除治疗。D&Q治疗改善了运动行为、神经肌肉功能，并减少了通过血浆神经丝轻链测得的轴突损伤，同时伴有运动皮层兴奋性的显著改善和V层神经元计数的保留。在细胞水平上，基于小胶质细胞TDP-43负荷和衰老标志物的减少，皮层小胶质细胞被认为是衰老细胞清除获益的潜在介导者。总之，这些发现将细胞衰老确定为ALS病理的一个早期、疾病相关且可修饰的特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究在2026年发表，首次在TDP-43 Q331K ALS小鼠中系统证明细胞衰老是早期可修饰特征，并显示已上市衰老细胞清除药物D&Q可改善多维度ALS病理，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Motor coordination and behavioural deficits in a mouse model of KMT2B-related dystonia.
items.summary: Pathogenic variants in KMT2B cause early-onset dystonia, but a mouse model that has undergone comprehensive, dystonia-oriented phenotyping is lacking. We conducted detailed phenotyping on heterozygous Kmt2b constitutive knockout mice and wild-type littermates, assessing growth, neurobehavioural traits, motor coordination, sensorimotor gating, social behaviour and metabolic parameters, combined with striatal RNA sequencing. Kmt2b knockout mice of both sexes were viable but significantly smaller and lighter than littermate controls. Knockouts were hyperlocomotive in the open field and showed approximately two-fold larger acoustic startle responses; unexpectedly, prepulse inhibition was enhanced rather than reduced at all prepulse intensities. On the balance beam, knockouts crossed more slowly and paused more frequently; female knockouts also paused more on the ladder rung task. Frame-by-frame video analysis revealed a claw-like hindpaw posture characterized by abnormal inward flexion of the digits. Knockout mice spent less time investigating a novel conspecific, while social recognition memory remained intact. Striatal RNA sequencing confirmed reduction of Kmt2b transcript to approximately half of control levels and identified 177 differentially expressed genes, including Maob, encoding monoamine oxidase B; gene set enrichment analysis implicated neurodevelopmental, glial and mitochondrial processes. Nociception, vision, body-weight-adjusted grip strength, and clinical chemistry and haematological measures were largely unaffected. Heterozygous Kmt2b knockout mice show hyperlocomotion, altered sensorimotor gating, impaired motor coordination with dystonic-like paw posturing and reduced sociability, alongside a striatal transcriptomic signature implicating neurodevelopmental processes. The model mirrors aspects of human KMT2B-related dystonia and provides a platform for mechanistic study; environmental or pharmacological challenge may be needed to unmask overt dystonic features.
items.titleZh: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍小鼠模型中的运动协调与行为缺陷
items.summaryZh: 该研究对杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠进行了系统的行为与纹状体转录组分析，发现其存在活动过度、惊跳反应增强、前脉冲抑制反常增强、平衡木和梯级任务运动协调受损、爪样后爪姿势及社交探索减少，纹状体Kmt2b转录本减半并出现177个差异表达基因，涉及神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程。该模型部分再现人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍特征，但未出现明显自发性肌张力障碍发作，提示可能需要额外挑战才能显现。
items.insight: KMT2B相关肌张力障碍与ALS同属神经退行/神经发育相关运动障碍，该模型提供了可复用的行为学与纹状体转录组表型框架，有助于理解运动协调缺陷、感觉运动门控异常和线粒体/胶质通路在运动神经元及运动环路疾病中的共性机制。

items.abstractZh: KMT2B的致病性变异可导致早发性肌张力障碍，但目前尚缺乏经过全面、以肌张力障碍为导向的表型分析的小鼠模型。我们对杂合Kmt2b组成型敲除小鼠及其野生型同窝对照进行了详细表型分析，评估了生长、神经行为特征、运动协调、感觉运动门控、社会行为和代谢参数，并结合纹状体RNA测序。两种性别的Kmt2b敲除小鼠均可存活，但体型和体重显著小于同窝对照。敲除小鼠在旷场中表现出活动过度，听觉惊跳反应约增大两倍；出乎意料的是，在所有前脉冲强度下，前脉冲抑制均增强而非减弱。在平衡木上，敲除小鼠通过速度更慢、停顿更频繁；雌性敲除小鼠在梯级任务中的停顿也更多。逐帧视频分析揭示了一种爪样后爪姿势，其特征为趾部异常向内弯曲。敲除小鼠探索新异同种个体的时间减少，而社会识别记忆保持完整。纹状体RNA测序证实Kmt2b转录本降至对照水平约一半，并鉴定出177个差异表达基因，包括编码单胺氧化酶B的Maob；基因集富集分析提示神经发育、胶质和线粒体过程参与其中。痛觉、视觉、体重校正后的握力以及临床化学和血液学指标基本未受影响。杂合Kmt2b敲除小鼠表现出活动过度、感觉运动门控改变、运动协调受损伴肌张力障碍样爪姿势以及社交能力下降，同时伴有提示神经发育过程的纹状体转录组特征。该模型反映了人类KMT2B相关肌张力障碍的某些方面，为机制研究提供了平台；可能需要环境或药物挑战才能揭示明显的肌张力障碍特征。
items.frontierRationale: 该新近动物模型首次对KMT2B相关肌张力障碍进行系统行为与纹状体转录组表型分析，为ALS等运动障碍疾病的机制研究和转化挑战实验提供了可借鉴平台。

items.title: Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicle phosphorylated TDP-43 as a blood-based biomarker for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease characterized by central nervous system (CNS) neuroglial TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) pathology in ∼90-95% of cases. Non-invasive biomarkers are critically needed to reduce diagnostic delay, enable patient stratification, and assess treatment efficacy in clinical trials. Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicles (ADEVs) represent promising CNS liquid biopsy biomarkers, given astrocyte involvement in ALS pathogenesis and the ability of ADEVs to cross the blood-brain barrier and carry TDP-43. Here, we assessed the diagnostic performance of TDP-43 and its hyperphosphorylated pathological form, phospho-Ser409 (pTDP-43), quantified in ADEVs, for distinguishing ALS cases from matched healthy controls. ADEVs were immunoisolated from whole blood (n = 76) and plasma (n = 86) across three ALS biorepositories/cohorts. ADEV quality and enrichment were validated in accordance with minimal information for studies of extracellular vesicles guidelines, and protein levels were normalized by ratio to tetraspanin cluster of differentiation 81 (CD81). Diagnostic accuracy was evaluated by logistic regression and random forest models with cross-validation, adjusting for age and sex across 100 random seeds. Plasma ADEV pTDP-43/CD81 ratio best predicted ALS case status, with a mean AUC of 0.89 (95% CI: 0.75-0.99) from logistic models, corresponding to a mean sensitivity and specificity of 87% and 89%, respectively, and a mean AUC of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.82-0.90) from random forest models. Although the specificity of ADEV pTDP-43 relative to disease mimics and associations with disease progression require further investigation, these findings support its potential as a biomarker candidate for ALS and for patient stratification in TDP-43-targeted clinical trials.
items.titleZh: 星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡磷酸化TDP-43作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症的血源性生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 该研究评估了星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）中的磷酸化TDP-43（pTDP-43）作为ALS血源性生物标志物的诊断性能。在三个队列的全血和血浆样本中，血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值在区分ALS与健康对照时表现最佳，逻辑回归模型平均AUC达0.89，随机森林模型平均AUC为0.86。研究提示该指标有望用于ALS诊断和TDP-43靶向试验的患者分层，但其对疾病模拟者的特异性及与疾病进展的关联仍需进一步验证。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS提供了一种基于血液的CNS来源液体活检策略，直接捕获星形胶质细胞释放的病理TDP-43，有望解决ALS诊断延迟和临床试验患者分层两大瓶颈。其跨血脑屏障的ADEV载体特性使其区别于传统血浆总TDP-43检测，若能在独立队列中验证对疾病模拟者的特异性，可能成为TDP-43靶向治疗试验的富集工具。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，约90-95%的病例以中枢神经系统（CNS）神经胶质细胞TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）病理为特征。目前迫切需要非侵入性生物标志物以减少诊断延迟、实现患者分层并评估临床试验中的治疗效果。鉴于星形胶质细胞参与ALS发病机制，且星形胶质细胞来源的细胞外囊泡（ADEVs）能够穿越血脑屏障并携带TDP-43，ADEVs代表了一种有前景的CNS液体活检生物标志物。在此，我们评估了在ADEVs中定量的TDP-43及其过度磷酸化病理形式——磷酸化Ser409（pTDP-43）——在区分ALS病例与匹配健康对照中的诊断性能。ADEVs从三个ALS生物样本库/队列的全血（n=76）和血浆（n=86）中免疫分离。ADEV质量和富集度按照细胞外囊泡研究最低信息指南进行验证，蛋白质水平通过与四跨膜蛋白分化簇81（CD81）的比值进行归一化。诊断准确性通过逻辑回归和随机森林模型结合交叉验证进行评估，并在100个随机种子中调整年龄和性别。血浆ADEV pTDP-43/CD81比值最能预测ALS病例状态，逻辑回归模型的平均AUC为0.89（95% CI：0.75-0.99），对应平均敏感性和特异性分别为87%和89%，随机森林模型的平均AUC为0.86（95% CI：0.82-0.90）。尽管ADEV pTDP-43相对于疾病模拟者的特异性及其与疾病进展的关联需要进一步研究，但这些发现支持其作为ALS生物标志物候选物以及用于TDP-43靶向临床试验中患者分层的潜力。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近报道了星形胶质细胞来源细胞外囊泡中的磷酸化TDP-43作为ALS血源性生物标志物，具有直接支持TDP-43靶向临床试验患者分层的转化价值。

items.title: Targeting lysosomal dysfunction with small-molecule TRPML1 ligands: Therapeutic opportunities in lysosomal storage disorders, neurodegeneration and beyond.
items.summary: TRPML1, a lysosomal Ca 2+ channel, has emerged as a clinically relevant target due to its genetic and mechanistic links to lysosomal storage disorders and neurodegenerative diseases, including Gaucher disease, Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. This evidence has prompted TRPML1 drug discovery efforts across academia and industry, with several small-molecule agonists advancing toward clinical development. In this review, we provide a comprehensive overview of the therapeutic potential of TRPML1 as a molecular target from a medicinal chemistry perspective. We summarize the structural basis of channel activation and inhibition, highlighting insights from recent cryo-EM studies that define the principal ligand-binding sites and mechanisms of allosteric modulation. We systematically survey the chemical space of TRPML1 ligands reported to date, including diverse agonist and antagonist chemotypes, and extend this analysis to encompass undisclosed or recently disclosed compounds emerging from industry pipelines. Furthermore, we discuss key determinants of ligand design and developability, including the challenges associated with targeting a deeply embedded, lipophilic binding pocket within the membrane. Overall, the available evidence positions TRPML1 as a promising target for small-molecule drug discovery and provides a framework for the rational design of next-generation lysosome-directed therapeutics.
items.titleZh: 靶向溶酶体功能障碍的小分子TRPML1配体：在溶酶体贮积症、神经退行性疾病及其他疾病中的治疗机会
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述从药物化学角度系统梳理了溶酶体钙通道TRPML1作为治疗靶点的潜力。TRPML1与戈谢病、帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病及肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病存在遗传和机制关联，目前已有多个小分子激动剂向临床开发推进。文章总结了TRPML1激活与抑制的结构基础、冷冻电镜揭示的配体结合位点与变构调节机制，并系统调查了已报道的激动剂和拮抗剂化学型，包括工业管线中未公开或新公开的化合物。文章还讨论了靶向膜内深埋亲脂性结合口袋的配体设计与可开发性挑战。
items.insight: TRPML1是溶酶体钙信号的核心通道，其功能异常与ALS相关的溶酶体自噬障碍、脂质代谢紊乱等病理过程密切相关。这篇综述不仅汇总了TRPML1配体的化学空间和结构生物学进展，还纳入了工业管线中尚未公开的化合物信息，为ALS研究者提供了从靶点结构到药物化学优化的全景视角。对于关注溶酶体功能障碍在ALS中作用的团队，该文可作为评估TRPML1作为干预节点的转化潜力及设计下一代溶酶体导向疗法的参考框架。

aiRead.keyFinding: TRPML1因与溶酶体贮积症和包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病的遗传和机制联系成为临床相关靶点，已有多个小分子激动剂向临床开发推进，冷冻电镜研究揭示了其配体结合位点和变构调节机制。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为综述，不提供原始实验数据或临床疗效结果；TRPML1配体仍面临靶向膜内深埋亲脂性结合口袋的挑战，且工业管线中部分化合物信息未公开。

items.abstractZh: TRPML1是一种溶酶体Ca2+通道，因其与溶酶体贮积症和神经退行性疾病（包括戈谢病、帕金森病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化）的遗传和机制联系，已成为一个临床相关靶点。这些证据推动了学术界和工业界对TRPML1的药物发现工作，已有多个小分子激动剂向临床开发推进。在这篇综述中，我们从药物化学角度全面概述了TRPML1作为分子靶点的治疗潜力。我们总结了通道激活和抑制的结构基础，重点介绍了近期冷冻电镜研究的见解，这些研究定义了主要的配体结合位点和变构调节机制。我们系统地调查了迄今为止报道的TRPML1配体的化学空间，包括多种激动剂和拮抗剂化学型，并将此分析扩展到涵盖来自工业管线中未公开或最近公开的化合物。此外，我们讨论了配体设计和可开发性的关键决定因素，包括靶向膜内深埋的亲脂性结合口袋所面临的挑战。总体而言，现有证据将TRPML1定位为小分子药物发现的有前景靶点，并为下一代溶酶体导向治疗药物的合理设计提供了框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了近期冷冻电镜结构研究与工业管线化合物信息，系统阐述了TRPML1作为溶酶体靶点在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的小分子药物发现前沿进展。

items.title: Cerebrospinal fluid inflammatory proteomic profiling identifies biomarkers linked to disease progression in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Neuroinflammation is a key component of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but its association with disease progression heterogeneity remains unclear. We aimed to identify CSF inflammation-related proteins associated with disease progression phenotype in patients with ALS. Patients with ALS were stratified into slow progressors (SP) and fast progressors (FP) according to the disease progression rate. CSF inflammatory proteins were measured using the Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel. Disease-associated biomarkers were identified using limma package and elastic net (EN) analysis. We assessed the discriminatory power of disease-associated biomarkers using receiver operating characteristic curve analysis and estimated the optimism-adjusted area under the curve (AUC) using the bootstrapping method. Among 77 patients (SP: n=40; FP: n=37), limma analysis identified 11 differentially expressed proteins, with functional enrichment in chemokine signaling, TNF-related responses and NF-κB pathways. EN analysis identified 12 candidate proteins, among which CST5, CCL11, SIRT2, CD6, CCL4, MMP-1, TNFRSF9, CCL19, and MCP-4 showed positive associations with the SP phenotype. A model combining SIRT2, MMP-1, BMI, and site of onset yielded an apparent area under the curve of 0.769 (95% CI 0.662 to 0.876) and an optimism-corrected area under the curve of 0.729. Our study uncovered a CSF inflammatory proteomic signature associated with slow disease progression in ALS. These findings indicate that specific CSF neuroinflammatory protein signatures reflect biological heterogeneity in ALS disease progression rather than non-specific neurodegeneration. SIRT2 and MMP-1 warrant further investigation as components of progression-stratification models, although validation in larger, longitudinal, and independent cohorts is required.
items.titleZh: 脑脊液炎症蛋白质组学分析识别与肌萎缩侧索硬化疾病进展相关的生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性临床研究对77例ALS患者的脑脊液进行了炎症蛋白质组学分析，按疾病进展速率分为慢进展者和快进展者。研究发现11种差异表达蛋白，并构建了一个结合SIRT2、MMP-1、BMI和起病部位的模型，其乐观校正后AUC为0.729，提示特定脑脊液炎症蛋白特征与ALS慢进展表型相关。研究强调这些标志物反映的是疾病进展的生物学异质性，而非非特异性神经退行性变，但尚需更大规模纵向独立队列验证。
items.insight: 该研究将脑脊液炎症蛋白质组与ALS疾病进展速率直接关联，提出了可用于进展分层的候选生物标志物组合（SIRT2、MMP-1等），为理解ALS进展异质性的免疫机制提供了新线索。尽管样本量有限且为横断面观察性设计，但其发现的蛋白特征若能在纵向队列中验证，可能有助于临床试验的患者分层和预后评估。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性临床研究（横断面队列分析）
aiRead.keyFinding: 脑脊液炎症蛋白质组特征与ALS慢进展表型相关，结合SIRT2、MMP-1、BMI和起病部位的模型乐观校正AUC为0.729。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（77例），为单中心横断面研究，缺乏独立队列验证，无法确定因果关系。
aiRead.watchNext: 需要在更大规模、纵向、独立队列中验证SIRT2和MMP-1等候选标志物的预测价值，并探索其与神经退行性变标志物（如NfL）的联合应用。

items.abstractZh: 神经炎症是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的关键组成部分，但其与疾病进展异质性的关联仍不清楚。我们旨在识别与ALS患者疾病进展表型相关的脑脊液炎症相关蛋白。根据疾病进展速率将ALS患者分为慢进展者（SP）和快进展者（FP）。使用Olink Target 96 Inflammation panel测量脑脊液炎症蛋白。使用limma包和弹性网络（EN）分析识别疾病相关生物标志物。我们使用受试者工作特征曲线分析评估疾病相关生物标志物的区分能力，并使用自举法估计乐观校正后的曲线下面积（AUC）。在77例患者中（SP：n=40；FP：n=37），limma分析识别出11种差异表达蛋白，功能富集于趋化因子信号传导、TNF相关反应和NF-κB通路。EN分析识别出12种候选蛋白，其中CST5、CCL11、SIRT2、CD6、CCL4、MMP-1、TNFRSF9、CCL19和MCP-4与SP表型呈正相关。结合SIRT2、MMP-1、BMI和起病部位的模型得出的表观曲线下面积为0.769（95% CI 0.662至0.876），乐观校正后的曲线下面积为0.729。我们的研究揭示了与ALS慢疾病进展相关的脑脊液炎症蛋白质组特征。这些发现表明，特定的脑脊液神经炎症蛋白特征反映了ALS疾病进展的生物学异质性，而非非特异性神经退行性变。SIRT2和MMP-1作为进展分层模型的组成部分值得进一步研究，但需要在更大规模、纵向和独立队列中进行验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用高通量炎症蛋白质组学新近揭示了与ALS疾病进展速率相关的脑脊液生物标志物特征，具有潜在的转化价值，可用于进展分层模型的开发。

items.title: Mdivi-1 regulates mitochondrial fission and function via the CaMK2/Drp1 pathway in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease involving progressive motor neuron loss. Given the high energy reliance of motor neurons, mitochondrial dysfunction especially excessive fission critically contributes to disease pathogenesis. Mitochondrial division inhibitor-1 (Mdivi-1), an inhibitor of the fission protein Drp1, has shown neuroprotective potential, but its mechanism of action on mitochondrial quality control in ALS remains unclear. Here, we examined the effects of Mdivi-1 on mitochondrial dysfunction and cell injury in NSC34 cells expressing mutant SOD1^G93A and in SOD1^G93A transgenic mice. ALS models exhibited increased reactive oxygen species accumulation, reduced mitochondrial content, loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, enhanced apoptotic signaling, and increased phosphorylation of CaMK2 and Drp1. Mdivi-1 treatment improved cell viability, reduced oxidative stress, restored mitochondrial integrity and membrane potential, and suppressed apoptosis. In addition, Mdivi-1 decreased Drp1 phosphorylation, whereas co-treatment with the CaMK2 activator DCP-LA partially reversed these effects. Furthermore, direct inhibition of CaMK2 with KN93 reduced CaMK2 and Drp1 phosphorylation, providing additional evidence that CaMK2 regulates Drp1 activation in SOD1^G93A cells. These findings indicate that pharmacological modulation of the CaMK2/Drp1 pathway can attenuate aberrant mitochondrial fission and associated cellular dysfunction in ALS models.
items.titleZh: Mdivi-1通过CaMK2/Drp1通路调控肌萎缩侧索硬化中的线粒体分裂与功能
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1^G93A ALS细胞和小鼠模型中证实，线粒体分裂抑制剂Mdivi-1可改善细胞活力、减轻氧化应激、恢复线粒体功能并抑制凋亡。机制上，Mdivi-1通过抑制CaMK2/Drp1通路减少异常线粒体分裂，而CaMK2激活剂可部分逆转其保护效应。
items.insight: 该研究将CaMK2/Drp1轴确立为ALS中线粒体过度分裂的上游调控节点，为靶向线粒体质量控制提供了可成药的通路依据。Mdivi-1虽为工具化合物，但CaMK2作为激酶具有更好的成药性，值得进一步评估其选择性抑制剂在ALS模型中的转化潜力。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前基础研究（细胞与转基因小鼠模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: Mdivi-1通过抑制CaMK2/Drp1通路减轻SOD1^G93A ALS模型中的异常线粒体分裂、氧化应激和凋亡，改善线粒体功能。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1^G93A模型，未涵盖其他ALS遗传亚型或散发性ALS；Mdivi-1的体内疗效、血脑屏障穿透性和长期安全性未充分评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注CaMK2选择性抑制剂在ALS动物模型中的疗效验证，以及Mdivi-1或CaMK2靶向药物向临床转化的药代动力学和安全性数据。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种涉及进行性运动神经元丢失的致死性神经退行性疾病。鉴于运动神经元对能量的高度依赖，线粒体功能障碍尤其是过度分裂在疾病发病机制中起关键作用。线粒体分裂抑制剂-1（Mdivi-1）作为分裂蛋白Drp1的抑制剂，已显示出神经保护潜力，但其在ALS中对线粒体质量控制的作用机制尚不清楚。本研究检测了Mdivi-1对表达突变型SOD1^G93A的NSC34细胞及SOD1^G93A转基因小鼠中线粒体功能障碍和细胞损伤的影响。ALS模型表现出活性氧积累增加、线粒体含量减少、线粒体膜电位丢失、凋亡信号增强以及CaMK2和Drp1磷酸化增加。Mdivi-1处理改善了细胞活力，减少了氧化应激，恢复了线粒体完整性和膜电位，并抑制了凋亡。此外，Mdivi-1降低了Drp1磷酸化，而与CaMK2激活剂DCP-LA共处理可部分逆转这些效应。进一步，用KN93直接抑制CaMK2可降低CaMK2和Drp1磷酸化，提供了CaMK2在SOD1^G93A细胞中调控Drp1激活的额外证据。这些发现表明，药理学调控CaMK2/Drp1通路可减轻ALS模型中的异常线粒体分裂及相关细胞功能障碍。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了CaMK2/Drp1通路在ALS线粒体分裂中的调控机制，为靶向线粒体功能障碍的转化研究提供了新靶点。

items.title: Nitrate-responsive Sialin2 couples stress granule assembly and clearance to maintain neuronal homeostasis.
items.summary: Stress granules (SGs) are phase-separated ribonucleoprotein condensates that support cellular adaptation to acute stress, but how extracellular signals coordinate their assembly and recovery-phase clearance remains unclear. Here, we show that nitrate-responsive Sialin2 coordinates SG homeostasis across the stress cycle. During acute stress, Sialin2 undergoes liquid-liquid phase separation and co-assembles with Ras GTPase-activating protein SH3-domain-binding protein (G3BP)-centered scaffolds to promote SG formation. During recovery, Sialin2 preserves liquid-like SG dynamics and promotes autophagy-linked clearance. Sialin2 loss delays SG resolution, promotes retention of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)-linked fused in sarcoma (FUS) and TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) variants, and enhances amyloid precursor protein (APP)-related amyloidogenic output. In an ALS mouse model, nitrate treatment reduces SG-like pathology and neuroinflammation, preserves neuronal integrity, and delays functional decline. Together, these findings define a nitrate-Sialin2 signaling module that couples SG assembly to recovery-phase clearance and links inorganic anion sensing to protection against neurodegeneration.
items.titleZh: 硝酸盐响应性Sialin2偶联应激颗粒组装与清除以维持神经元稳态
items.summaryZh: 该研究发现硝酸盐响应蛋白Sialin2在应激颗粒形成和清除中起关键协调作用。急性应激时，Sialin2通过相分离与G3BP共组装促进应激颗粒形成；恢复期则维持应激颗粒流动性并促进自噬清除。Sialin2缺失会导致ALS相关蛋白FUS和TDP-43滞留，并增加淀粉样蛋白生成。在ALS小鼠模型中，硝酸盐治疗可减少应激颗粒样病理和神经炎症，保护神经元并延缓功能衰退。
items.insight: 这项研究将无机阴离子感知、应激颗粒动态调控与ALS相关蛋白稳态联系起来，提出了硝酸盐-Sialin2信号轴作为潜在干预靶点。其动物模型结果提示硝酸盐治疗可能具有转化潜力，但尚需临床验证。

aiRead.keyFinding: 硝酸盐响应性Sialin2通过相分离促进应激颗粒组装，并在恢复期促进自噬相关清除；其缺失导致ALS相关蛋白滞留，而硝酸盐治疗在ALS小鼠模型中减轻病理并延缓功能衰退。
aiRead.limitation: 研究主要基于细胞和动物模型，尚未在人类ALS患者中验证硝酸盐-Sialin2通路的治疗有效性与安全性。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续需关注Sialin2在人类ALS样本中的表达与功能变化，以及硝酸盐干预的临床转化研究进展。

items.abstractZh: 应激颗粒（SGs）是相分离的核糖核蛋白凝聚体，支持细胞对急性应激的适应，但细胞外信号如何协调其组装与恢复期清除仍不清楚。在此，我们发现硝酸盐响应性Sialin2在整个应激周期中协调SG稳态。在急性应激期间，Sialin2发生液-液相分离，并与以Ras GTP酶激活蛋白SH3结构域结合蛋白（G3BP）为中心的支架共组装，促进SG形成。在恢复期，Sialin2维持液态样SG动态并促进自噬相关清除。Sialin2缺失延迟SG解聚，促进ALS相关融合肉瘤（FUS）和TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）变体的滞留，并增强淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）相关的淀粉样生成输出。在ALS小鼠模型中，硝酸盐治疗减少SG样病理和神经炎症，保护神经元完整性，并延缓功能衰退。总之，这些发现定义了一个硝酸盐-Sialin2信号模块，将SG组装与恢复期清除偶联，并将无机阴离子感知与神经退行性变的保护联系起来。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近揭示了硝酸盐-Sialin2模块协调应激颗粒组装与清除，并直接关联ALS相关FUS/TDP-43病理，具有明确的神经退行性变转化价值。

items.title: From patient cells to patient therapy: Twenty years of iPSC-based translation in neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Twenty years after the discovery of induced pluripotent stem cells, the field has progressed from patient-specific disease modeling toward cell-based therapies for neurodegenerative disorders. Parkinson's disease has emerged as the leading model for neuronal replacement, whereas Huntington's disease, Alzheimer's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis require distinct combinations of circuit reconstruction, cellular support, immune modulation, and engineered therapeutic delivery. We discuss key determinants of clinical translation, including cell source, product identity, graft composition, graft-host interactions, manufacturing reproducibility, genomic integrity, and clinical evaluation. We propose that the interval between cell transplantation and long-term engraftment constitutes a biological "black box" in which graft fate and therapeutic outcome are determined. As regenerative medicine enters its third decade, future progress will depend not only on generating therapeutic cells but also on elucidating and engineering the biological processes that determine their fate after transplantation, marking a conceptual transition from stem cell biology toward transplantation biology.
items.titleZh: 从患者细胞到患者治疗：诱导多能干细胞在神经退行性疾病中二十年的转化历程
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述回顾了诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）用于神经退行性疾病治疗二十年的转化历程。文章指出，帕金森病是神经元替代治疗最成熟的模型，而ALS等疾病需要更复杂的策略，包括回路重建、细胞支持、免疫调节和工程化递送。作者强调，移植后到长期植入之间的“黑箱”期是决定移植物命运和疗效的关键，未来需从干细胞生物学转向移植生物学。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS的iPSC细胞治疗提供了转化框架，明确指出了移植后“黑箱”期这一关键瓶颈，提示ALS研究者需关注移植物-宿主相互作用、免疫调节和工程化递送策略，而非仅聚焦于细胞生成。

aiRead.keyFinding: iPSC治疗神经退行性疾病已从疾病建模走向细胞治疗，但移植后到长期植入之间的“黑箱”期是决定疗效的关键，未来需从干细胞生物学转向移植生物学。
aiRead.limitation: 作为综述，未提供原始实验数据，且未针对ALS提出具体的移植方案或临床前验证结果。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对ALS的iPSC移植后“黑箱”期研究，特别是移植物-宿主相互作用、免疫调节和工程化递送策略的临床前及早期临床进展。

items.abstractZh: 在诱导多能干细胞发现二十年后，该领域已从患者特异性疾病建模迈向针对神经退行性疾病的细胞治疗。帕金森病已成为神经元替代治疗的主要模型，而亨廷顿病、阿尔茨海默病和肌萎缩侧索硬化则需要回路重建、细胞支持、免疫调节和工程化治疗递送的不同组合。我们讨论了临床转化的关键决定因素，包括细胞来源、产品特性、移植物组成、移植物-宿主相互作用、生产可重复性、基因组完整性和临床评估。我们提出，细胞移植与长期植入之间的间隔构成了一个生物学“黑箱”，移植物命运和治疗结局在此决定。随着再生医学进入第三个十年，未来的进展不仅取决于生成治疗性细胞，还取决于阐明和工程化决定移植后命运的生物学过程，这标志着从干细胞生物学向移植生物学的概念转变。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，系统总结了iPSC在神经退行性疾病中二十年的转化经验，并提出了移植生物学这一新概念，对ALS细胞治疗策略的优化具有直接指导价值。

items.title: Acidic cannabinoids in brain disorders: Neurobiological mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and translational challenges.
items.summary: Acidic cannabinoids, including tetrahydrocannabinolic acid (THCA), cannabidiolic acid (CBDA), cannabigerolic acid (CBGA), and related biosynthetic precursors, represent the predominant phytocannabinoid forms naturally produced by Cannabis sativa. Long considered pharmacologically inactive intermediates, these compounds are now increasingly recognized as bioactive molecules with potential therapeutic relevance for brain disorders. Compared with their decarboxylated counterparts, acidic cannabinoids exhibit distinct physicochemical, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamic properties that may confer reduced psychotropic liability together with unique neurobiological effects. Emerging preclinical evidence indicates that acidic cannabinoids modulate multiple processes implicated in neurological and psychiatric disorders, including serotonergic and endocannabinoid signaling, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, calcium dyshomeostasis, and synaptic transmission. In this review, we critically examine current knowledge regarding acidic cannabinoids in the context of brain disorders. We first summarize their biosynthesis, chemical stability, pharmacokinetic characteristics, and pharmacological differences from neutral cannabinoids. We then examine preclinical evidence supporting their potential therapeutic effects in epilepsy, anxiety, depression, psychosis-related conditions, and neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We also discuss how artificial intelligence and computational approaches may support target identification, formulation optimization, pharmacokinetic modeling, and the development of personalized cannabinoid-based interventions. Finally, we highlight key methodological and translational challenges limiting the field and outline priorities for future research. Overall, acidic cannabinoids emerge as promising but still underexplored multitarget compounds with potential relevance for the treatment of brain disorders.
items.titleZh: 酸性大麻素在脑部疾病中的作用：神经生物学机制、临床前证据与转化挑战
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理了酸性大麻素（THCA、CBDA、CBGA等）在脑部疾病中的神经生物学机制与临床前证据。文章指出，这些曾被忽视的天然大麻素前体具有生物活性，可调节神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能、钙稳态和突触传递等多个ALS相关病理过程。综述覆盖了包括ALS在内的多种神经退行性疾病，并探讨了AI在靶点识别和药物开发中的应用，同时指出了当前研究的方法学局限和转化障碍。
items.insight: 该综述将酸性大麻素这一长期被忽视的天然化合物类别与ALS等神经退行性疾病的多条核心病理通路（神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激、钙稳态失衡）联系起来，为ALS药物开发提供了新的多靶点候选方向。同时，文章讨论了AI辅助的靶点识别和药代动力学建模，这对加速大麻素类化合物的转化研究具有方法学参考价值。尽管目前仅有临床前证据，但其对酸性大麻素独特药理特性的系统梳理，有助于研究者重新评估这类化合物在ALS治疗中的潜力。

aiRead.keyFinding: 酸性大麻素（THCA、CBDA、CBGA等）具有区别于中性大麻素的独特药理特性，临床前证据支持其通过调节神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能和钙稳态等多靶点机制，对包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病具有潜在治疗相关性。

items.abstractZh: 酸性大麻素，包括四氢大麻酚酸（THCA）、大麻二酚酸（CBDA）、大麻萜酚酸（CBGA）及相关生物合成前体，是Cannabis sativa天然产生的主要植物大麻素形式。这些化合物长期被视为药理上无活性的中间体，如今日益被认为是对脑部疾病具有潜在治疗相关性的生物活性分子。与其脱羧对应物相比，酸性大麻素表现出独特的理化、药代动力学和药效学特性，可能赋予其较低的精神活性倾向以及独特的神经生物学效应。新兴的临床前证据表明，酸性大麻素可调节与神经和精神疾病相关的多个过程，包括5-羟色胺能和内源性大麻素信号传导、神经炎症、氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、钙稳态失衡以及突触传递。在本综述中，我们批判性地审视了当前关于酸性大麻素在脑部疾病背景下的知识。我们首先总结其生物合成、化学稳定性、药代动力学特征以及与中性大麻素的药理学差异。随后，我们审视支持其在癫痫、焦虑、抑郁、精神病相关状况以及神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化）中潜在治疗效果的临床前证据。我们还讨论了人工智能和计算方法如何支持靶点识别、制剂优化、药代动力学建模以及个性化大麻素干预措施的开发。最后，我们强调了限制该领域的关键方法学和转化挑战，并概述了未来研究的优先事项。总体而言，酸性大麻素作为有前景但仍未被充分探索的多靶点化合物，对脑部疾病的治疗具有潜在相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近系统整合了酸性大麻素在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的临床前证据，并引入AI辅助开发视角，为这一未被充分探索的多靶点化合物类别提供了转化研究路线图。

items.title: Associations Between Prediagnosis Plasma Neurofilament Light Polypeptide and Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Risk in the Danish EPIC Cohort.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease with a rapid time from symptoms onset to diagnosis. Elevated neurofilament light polypeptide (NfL) is well-established in symptomatic ALS and up to 5 years prediagnosis, but earlier timeframes remain understudied. We aimed to assess plasma NfL levels up to 23 years before ALS diagnosis and the relation to ALS risk. We conducted a nested matched case-control study within the Danish EPIC cohort (baseline 1993-1997) including 166 ALS cases (diagnosed 1997-2017) and 332 controls matched on birth year and sex. Plasma samples collected 0.4 to 23.2 years (median 14.1 years) prediagnosis were analyzed for NfL using Olink Target 96. Odds ratios were estimated using conditional logistic regression. Discriminatory performance was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic curves. NfL levels were elevated in ALS cases relative to controls up to 14.6 years before diagnosis. Among those with blood samples collected <5, 5 to 14.6, and >14.6 years before diagnosis, the odds ratios (95% CI) for ALS per standard deviation increase in the normalized protein expression value of NfL were 3.8 (1.4-10.3), 1.7 (1.2-2.3), and 1.3 (0.9-1.7), respectively. The areas under the curve for ALS discrimination by NfL among those with blood collected <5 and 5-14.6 years before diagnosis were 0.78 and 0.63, respectively. Plasma NfL elevation may occur significantly earlier than previously reported, indicating a much longer ALS prodrome. Assuming other biomarker changes may also occur earlier, this raises the possibility of identifying at-risk individuals early that could benefit epidemiologic analyses, clinical trials, and prevention efforts. ANN NEUROL 2026.

items.summaryZh: 这项基于丹麦EPIC队列的巢式病例对照研究发现，ALS患者诊断前血浆NfL水平在诊断前长达14.6年即已升高，早于既往认为的5年窗口。诊断前<5年时NfL与ALS风险的关联最强（OR 3.8），判别能力也最高（AUC 0.78）；5-14.6年时关联减弱但仍显著（OR 1.7，AUC 0.63）；超过14.6年则无显著关联。结果提示ALS前驱期可能远长于既往认识，为极早期识别高危个体提供了线索。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致死性神经退行性疾病，从症状出现到诊断的时间很短。神经丝轻链多肽（NfL）升高在症状性ALS及诊断前长达5年内已得到充分证实，但更早的时间窗仍研究不足。我们旨在评估ALS诊断前长达23年的血浆NfL水平及其与ALS风险的关系。我们在丹麦EPIC队列（基线1993-1997年）内开展了一项巢式匹配病例对照研究，纳入166例ALS病例（1997-2017年诊断）和332例按出生年份和性别匹配的对照。采用Olink Target 96分析诊断前0.4至23.2年（中位数14.1年）采集的血浆样本中的NfL。使用条件logistic回归估计比值比。采用受试者工作特征曲线评估判别性能。与对照相比，ALS病例的NfL水平在诊断前长达14.6年即已升高。在诊断前<5年、5至14.6年及>14.6年采集血样的受试者中，NfL归一化蛋白表达值每增加一个标准差对应的ALS比值比（95% CI）分别为3.8（1.4-10.3）、1.7（1.2-2.3）和1.3（0.9-1.7）。在诊断前<5年和5-14.6年采集血液的受试者中，NfL判别ALS的曲线下面积分别为0.78和0.63。血浆NfL升高可能显著早于既往报道，提示ALS前驱期远更长。假设其他生物标志物变化也可能更早出现，这提高了早期识别高危个体的可能性，从而可能使流行病学分析、临床试验和预防工作受益。ANN NEUROL 2026。

items.title: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: This article describes the nerve loss underlying amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, its clinical manifestations, examination findings leading to the diagnosis, the expanding role of genetics, and available treatment and patient management. The cause of neuron death in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is not known, but many genes are strongly linked to the disease, in both patients with a family history and those with no history. A multistep pathologic process helps to explain the onset of symptoms later in life, even in patients with associated genes. Posttranslational and epigenetic changes are also important factors. Current clinical trials are based on putative pathologic mechanisms, and some newer therapies are gene-based. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis has distinctive features and can be diagnosed largely from the history and examination, and true mimics are rare. While the cause of neuronal death is not known, pathogenic and risk factor gene variations are present in a number of patients, and posttranscriptional and epigenetic changes are likely major causative factors. Environmental factors likely contribute, but specific avoidable factors have not been identified. Drugs to slow the progress of the disease are currently limited, but trials for all patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis continue, including a focus on genetic factors. Patient management is optimized in multidisciplinary amyotrophic lateral sclerosis clinics, and interventions for nutrition with gastric feeding tubes and respiratory insufficiency by noninvasive ventilation enhance patient comfort.

items.summaryZh: 这是一篇关于ALS的综述，系统梳理了该病的神经退行性基础、临床表现与诊断路径、遗传学进展以及当前治疗和患者管理策略。文章指出ALS的神经元死亡原因仍不明确，但遗传因素（包括家族性和散发性病例）、多步骤病理过程、翻译后修饰和表观遗传改变均被认为参与其中。诊断主要依靠病史和体格检查，真正的模拟病罕见。目前延缓疾病进展的药物有限，但针对所有ALS患者的临床试验仍在持续，部分新疗法基于基因。多学科门诊管理、胃造瘘营养支持和无创通气是优化患者管理的关键措施。
items.insight: 该综述来自神经病学继续教育类期刊，适合作为ALS研究者的背景更新材料。其价值在于：一是强调遗传因素在家族性和散发性ALS中均扮演重要角色，提示基因检测和遗传咨询应更广泛地纳入临床实践；二是提出多步骤病理模型解释晚年发病，为研究基因-环境交互作用提供框架；三是明确指出当前试验基于推测机制、新疗法向基因方向倾斜，有助于研究者把握临床试验设计趋势；四是强调表观遗传和翻译后修饰可能是主要致病因素，提示这些方向值得深入探索。
